summary: Huntsman filed an 8-K disclosing litigation related to its pending merger-of-equals with Olin. The Merger Agreement, dated June 15, 2026, provides for either a direct merger of Huntsman into Olin or a subsidiary merger structure, leaving Olin as ultimate parent. The joint proxy/prospectus was declared effective July 13, 2026; special meetings are set for August 25, 2026. Two stockholder complaints in New York Supreme Court allege omissions in the proxy statement, seeking injunctive relief. No deal terms (price, premium) were disclosed. Watch for supplemental disclosures or settlement; risk-arb focus is shareholder vote approval and litigation resolution.
